metadata.label: metapath
metadata.description: Cross-chain swap aggregator; its routes include SWFT and Bridgers. On TON its wallet also acts as the Bridgers liquidity treasury.

addresses.source: Apr-Sep 2026 on-chain: receives TON/USDT withdrawals from a Binance hot wallet and forwards them to the Bridgers main contract [EQCqTuPS-cMN9SSRhaFrwJOGL7dKkFF8C0a05g2WzI9uRJ19](https://tonviewer.com/EQCqTuPS-cMN9SSRhaFrwJOGL7dKkFF8C0a05g2WzI9uRJ19) (net $2.5-5.5M per month); it makes no payouts to users. The metapath.me front-end lists SWFT and Bridgers as its cross-chain routes.
addresses.comment: Deposit wallet and Bridgers liquidity treasury
